emily-support: FYI customer acme reported replies got noticeably shorter and a bit more abrupt after our 2026-02-24 model bump. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/ACME-1423 :wave:

sam-cs: Can you paste their exact repro prompt + the response they used to compare? customer says it started after ~deploy yesterday.

emily-support: pasted below (they included two responses). They say they were on model redwood-v2.1 then we rolled redwood-v2.2.

emily-support: ```
PROMPT: "Write a friendly onboarding email for a new user who signed up for our beta."
RESPONSE (v2.1): "Hey Jamie! Welcome aboard — we're excited to have you. To get started, open the app, follow the quick tour, and check out our guide. If you need anything, reply to this email or hit help. Cheers! :sparkles:"
RESPONSE (v2.2): "Welcome. The app has a tour and a guide. Contact support for issues."
```

jordan-ml: Yikes. That is subtle but measurable — tone, length, hedging removed. Do we have request/response logs + model tag?

emily-support: logs attached in the ticket — X-Request-ID headers: req_9f3a, req_9f3b. Customer said latency was fine. No errors.

ryan-eng: infra-bot shows a canary deploy for redwood-v2.2 at 1927999800 UTC across hosted-us-west. infra-bot: "deploy: redwood-v2.2 -> service/hosted-api (canary=10%)"

infra-bot: deploy: redwood-v2.2 -> service/hosted-api (canary=10%) by deploy-bot at 1927999800

jordan-ml: What changed between v2.1 and v2.2? Any decoding/penalty defaults altered? Any temperature or stop sequence defaults?

emily-support: internal note from model-onboarding: changed default top_p from 0.92 -> 0.85 for cost smoothing and applied a more aggressive length penalty on short completions for some checkpoints.

jordan-ml: That could explain truncation / brevity. Need to confirm if hosted routing used the new default profile or if customer pinned generation params. Are they calling completions with no explicit temperature/top_p?

emily-support: customer API call snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood","prompt":"..."}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***'``` so they did not set gen params.

sam-cs: Ok. Likely behavior change from defaults. Customer asks for a rollback or quick mitigation.

ryan-eng: Short term: we can route that customer's API key to the older param profile by mapping a legacy profile on their account. I can add a rule to route acct_acme to profile:legacy-gen-v2.1 which sets top_p=0.92, length_penalty=0.0.

jordan-ml: Also want to run a quick A/B eval across 100 prompts to quantify difference. I'll run eval harness and post metrics (avg tokens, politeness score).

emily-support: Customer asked for repro steps to validate on their side — please include exact curl + sample output so they can confirm.

jordan-ml: Copying a quick curl they can run: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <their-key>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.2","prompt":"Write a friendly onboarding email for a new user who signed up for our beta.","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.7}'```

jordan-ml: If they set max_tokens to 120 and temperature 0.7 we should see a fuller friendly email. If still short, send us the request-id and I'll trace.

emily-support: forwarded sample and suggested curl to customer. They responded: "Thanks — we'll run and report." :thumbsup: 

ryan-eng: I'm going to scope the account route change and have infra apply the profile override as a stopgap. ETA ~30m. @emily-support will confirm once done.

emily-support: Thank you. Also creating an internal bug for longer-term fix: adjust default generation profile to avoid aggressive brevity for plain prompts and add regression tests. ticket: https://redwood.ai/bugs/INF-987

sam-cs: Customer escalation notes: ask PM to communicate the reason for change and offer account-level profile mapping plus credits for the noisy experience.

jordan-ml: I'll attach eval results when ready. Initial quick run: v2.1 avg tokens=84, v2.2 avg tokens=45, politeness delta -0.32. Will follow up.

emily-support: update 1928000420: infra applied profile override for acct_acme -> legacy-gen-v2.1. Customer confirmed responses look back to normal in their test call. Closing escalation pending postmortem writeup. :white_check_mark:
